study: Typed-state feedback evolution with a randomized-feedback control
registration: Registered after v21 test and v22 development results; all new test evaluations are exploratory, not fresh confirmation
case_order: Initial8000 fixed for representation/vocabulary; remaining32000 admissions shuffled per seed. All arms within a seed share order. Seeds vary data order and optimizer jointly. Rounds are retrospective case blocks, not calendar-time deployment; patients may recur within training rounds.
representation: Frozen v22 word-plus-typed representation fitted on the initial8000 contexts only; unchanged128 target names
initial_state: One uniform initial8k model/tool reused identically across arms within seed; no pre-update feedback claim for initial training
feedback: Before revealing each new block's labels to the updater, predict with the error-prioritized arm's currently accepted model and threshold. Error is1 minus case drug F1 in the reachable128-name space, with perfect empty/empty agreement scored1. Weight is1+3*error.
randomized_control: Permute that exact block's error-weight vector with a separate deterministic seed. Thus error and randomized arms have identical weight distributions but different assignments. Initial8k weights are1; recorded weights persist, and cumulative weights are normalized to mean1.
order_tool: Shared within seed/round: fit the original conditional joint-order tool on exactly that round's seen cases and original word features. No future-round targets enter early tools. Rejected states retain their previous policy/tool bundle.
selection: Select threshold from0.1/0.15/0.2/0.25/0.3/0.4/0.5 on proposal. Promote if guard composite mean drug/order F1 improves and neither endpoint declines more than0.002. Separate selection/guard, reused across rounds.
output: At most20 drug names completed by the selected joint-order tool; missing attributes remain unknown
controls: ordinary uniform updates at identical epochs
freeze initial order tool inside final error-priority state
previous v21 word/character results as contextual reference, with different optimization budget explicitly disclosed
test_policy: All three seeds and arms finish selection before any new test inference. Evaluate accepted curves and raw proposed checkpoints; do not use test to select among them.
fixed: LLM weights (no LLM in this study)
statistics: Independent prediction recount, paired patient-cluster intervals2000 draws, seed mean/sample SD, fixes/regressions; descriptive with no multiplicity adjustment
claim_boundary: Supervised feedback-driven artifact evolution, not autonomous LLM skill/code evolution. More data or new feature representation alone cannot establish a unique RSI effect. Restricted data and models remain local. No API calls.
